title: Generated client contract and validation semantics
purpose: Define how generated client contracts, validation schemas, and capability-to-screen view-model mappings derive from USF semantic authority without creating runtime behaviour.

authorityPrinciples.requirement: Generated clients project USF commands, queries, workflows, events, validation, permissions, errors, and audit semantics from governed USF artefacts.
Generated clients MUST NOT introduce behaviour, permission rules, validation rules, errors, event semantics, provider semantics, or readiness claims that are not present in USF authority.
Client validation hints can improve interaction quality but MUST NOT weaken server-side validation or USF semantic validation authority.
Generated view-models are projections of semantic contracts and MUST NOT define product meaning by themselves.

derivationRules.requirement: Generated validation schemas derive from USF semantic authority and carry references to the source semantic definition.
Client-side validation is an interaction hint and MUST NOT satisfy or replace server-side validation authority.
Localized validation messages require i18n authority and MUST NOT be claimed complete by this artefact.
Generated validation schemas identify error-display and audit-event mappings where the source semantic definition requires them.

projectionRules.requirement: A generated screen or view-model projection requires a capability coverage entry.
View-model error states derive from USF error and validation semantics.
Empty states are interaction projections and MUST NOT change semantic state or authority.
Capability-to-screen mapping does not claim generated UI readiness, product UI readiness, or implementation readiness.

validatorRequirements.requirement: Future validators reject generated client contracts that omit required command, query, workflow, event, validation, permission, error, or audit mappings.
Future validators reject generated validation schemas that are stale, weaker than server validation, missing authority references, or unmapped to error display and audit semantics.
Future validators reject UI/view-model mappings without capability, permission, validation, audit, privacy, i18n, and accessibility references.

proofRequirements.requirement: Future proof records identify the semantic input set and commit used to generate each client contract and validation schema.
Future proof records show that each generated view-model projection maps back to capability coverage, validation, audit, privacy, i18n, and accessibility references.

implementationGate.reason: This artefact defines semantic requirements only. Client generation implementation, package publishing, runtime integration, form rendering, screens, components, design-system work, generated UI implementation, validator implementation, and readiness claims remain blocked until later authorised gates exist.
